title: Best pianists: Weatherford, Hines, Zinky Cohn, Lil Armstrong; Albert Nicholas
summary: He names Weatherford as best pianist, plus Hines, Cohn and Lil Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Is there anything else you can tell about the Jolly Row, how you liked his piano style, or was he considered about the best pianist?

The best pianist I remember was Weatherford, about the best pianist. I played with him at Rich Carlton, and he was about the best piano player I played with around. I played with Earl Hines a little. I played one or two jobs in Earl Hines. And this Zinke Korn. Oh yeah. I played with him. I heard him. Yeah.
He died not long ago. Yeah, he sure did. He was a nice piano player.
She was here last year. She's back in Paris and, oh she's back in Paris. Yeah. She's back in Rome now with Albert Nicholas. Do you remember Albert Nicholas?
Yeah, yeah. Sure, he's a alto sax guy.
